input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a not a risk associated with A facial editing system is designed to apply various filters and effects to user-generated images, utilizing AI-powered algorithms to modify and enhance facial features. The system aims to provide a range of editing options, allowing users to alter and refine their photos. It seeks to leverage machine learning techniques to deliver realistic and engaging image transformations.
